changes.text: Updates: check at start and once a day, Help > Check for Updates, status bar item, download with checks and exe swap, restart now or on next start
Explorer watcher test: give the watch a moment before changing files (wine sets up subfolder watches late); backlog: menu bar spacing, Help > Check for Updates
Ctrl+R: keep 100 recent folders, show ten and scroll through the rest with the arrows, PageUp/PageDown, the wheel or by typing
Remote: open folders in WSL - files through \wsl.localhost, git and the terminal inside the distro, polling for changes, remote indicator in the status bar
Ctrl+H in a terminal below the editor maximizes the panel to the editor's height and back; a chevron in the panel header does the same
Ctrl+R picks a recent folder by name in the palette, the open one left out; in a terminal Ctrl+R stays the shell's
Side bar: hide view tabs from their context menu, a hidden view opened by a shortcut shows its tab while open
Terminal: Nerd Font icons fallback, Ctrl+click links, find in output (Ctrl+F)
Diff tab: changed chars within lines, sideways scroll, next/previous change
Diff tab: a solid, wider scroll bar beside the text that frames the part on screen
